metadata.title: Y2K Urban Pop Album Cover Aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a male figure with short platinum hair, wearing a glossy red patent leather jacket and heavy silver jewelry. The subject is positioned on the right, looking directly at the camera with hands clasped near the face. The background is a clean, bright white with a faint, light-gray illustrative dragon watermark behind a bold, red, beveled title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's vibrant red jacket against a stark white background
Bold, beveled red typography overlapping a subtle gray graphic
High-gloss textures of the leather contrasting with the matte skin and hair
Silver jewelry providing bright metallic highlights against the red and white

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is right-aligned, occupying approximately two-thirds of the vertical frame, cropped at the waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glossy red jacket and the subject's direct gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the red jacket, then sweeps left to the large display title and the dragon watermark.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left side and top, providing room for typography and graphic elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant, high-saturation red for the jacket and main text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/Chrome for jewelry and hair; light gray for the background watermark.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high value (brightness) with a single high-saturation color (red) creating a punchy, commercial look.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Script-influenced serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Thick, rounded stems with thin connectors
Drop shadow for depth against the white background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter features an elongated, curved tail
Final letter includes a stylized accent mark or flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant decorative face paired with a small, utilitarian sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Faint line-art dragon illustration in the background
Geometric triangle frame behind the dragon

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base skeleton for the fluid movement.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a man with platinum hair in a shiny red patent leather jacket against a white background. Include a faint light-gray dragon line-art watermark in the upper left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, red, beveled 3D script text in the upper left, overlapping the dragon graphic. The text should have a glossy finish and a soft drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the red jacket texture visibly glossy/reflective?
Is the background pure white without shadows?
Does the text have a distinct 3D beveled appearance?
Is the dragon watermark subtle and light gray?

adjustableVariables: Amount of jewelry on the subject
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red jacket does not bleed into the white background.
Check that the platinum hair is bright silver, not yellow.
Verify the 3D text looks like a physical object with highlights.
Confirm the subject's gaze is direct and engaging.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + Glossy primary color garment + Faint background watermark + Beveled 3D display type.
